Directive 21: two of the four sorry-blocked goals in code/lean/ellis_gilmer_conjecture_refuted.lean are FALSE as stated and can never be discharged. Do NOT assign a prover to them until they are restated.

(1) gap_perturbed_strict (line 204) demands 0 < hsum f AND (sum over i of f i * log (1/f i)) < 0. But hsum f is DEFINED (line 40) as exactly that sum, so the goal asserts X > 0 and X < 0 for the same X. Unsatisfiable.

(2) gilmer_refuted_boundary (line 219) demands a distribution f with all f i > 0, sum f i = 1, and (sum of f i * log (1/f i)) < 0. That sum is Shannon entropy in nats, strictly POSITIVE whenever every f i lies in (0,1). Unsatisfiable.

Both goals mistakenly ask for the ENTROPY of p to be negative. Ellis's refutation says nothing of the kind. What is negative is quantity (1), the DIFFERENCE sum_s q_s log(1/p_s) minus sum_s p_s log(1/p_s), which the file already kernel-checks as (2/25)*log(2/3) < 0 at x = 3/10 via ellis_lhs_negative. Restate BOTH around that difference, not around hsum.

Restate shapes (per directive):
- gilmer_refuted_boundary: assert existence of x with 0 < x, x < 1/2, all marginals of mass x equal to 1/2, and LHS x < 0 — ellis_lhs_negative + boundary_distribution already give this at x = 3/10, so it becomes PROVABLE NOW rather than a sorry.
- gap_perturbed_strict: assert existence of epsilon > 0 and a distribution with every marginal strictly below 1/2, positive entropy, and the (1)-difference negative — stated with a perturbed-LHS function (mass with p'({1,2})=x−2ε etc.), NOT with hsum on both sides.

Keep the arithmetic core: 8 declarations rest on only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound — do not touch them. gap_union_weights and gap_entropy_rewrite are correctly stated and are the mechanical ones worth proving once the two false goals are restated.
